name: baseline590
note: control arm, no overrides -- the anchor every comparison grades against. Named baseline590 (not 'baseline') deliberately: the shared results volume banks rows by arm name, and a prior wave's 'baseline' rows at commit d56ef8b would satisfy the resume check and poison the comparison. First in the list, so check_sweep.py uses it as the base arm.

name: hist_v2_01
note: #590 v2 defaults at dose 0.1 / cap 0.5: contest event (frontier-blocker intersection, full weight), doubling escalation, evict-lowest guard. Local 4-board screen: safe small win on thrash (glasgow/ulx3s), neutral on structural boards.

name: hist_v2_02
note: #590 v2 at dose 0.2 / cap 1.0 -- the bracketing point; best glasgow arm locally (2 open nets -> 1).

name: hist_v1style
note: v1-style diffuse field (whole-footprint rip stamps + raw frontier 0.25, flat accumulation) PLUS the always-on v2 contest event and eviction guard. High-variance locally: ulx3s 4 open nets -> 1, but trackball 8 -> 10. The corpus decides.
